_note: The router rejects a client-list call whose client_secret doesn't belong to a payment. 'invalid_secret_format' passes the SDK's own format check (.+_secret_[A-Za-z0-9]+), so the SDK mounts and calls GET /payments/invalid/client; base clientList would answer any id with a card list. Body modelled on the router's HE_02 not-found error.

error.message: Payment does not exist in our records
